description: Golden set surfaced in the chat UI so a reviewer can reproduce a known-good answer without inventing a question. Two questions per indexed document, plus G13/G14 - a matched pair that Week 3 retrieval fails and Week 4 recovers, kept so the mode toggle can be demonstrated on a real case rather than described. Separate from golden_set.jsonl, which drives results.md sections 9-14 and must not shift when this list changes.

questions.question: What speed and data allowance does the AirFiber_1199_1M plan include?

questions.note: Dense ranks the answer 7th - six legacy packs in KB-007 describe data allowances in near-identical language, and 'fair usage cap' is generic phrasing that matches all of them. The literal AirFiber_1199_1M is the only disambiguator, which is precisely what BM25 scores and MiniLM averages away. Ask it with no document selected.
